key_idea: Aggregate counts per toy name in a map, then sort by (count descending, name ascending).
sketch: For each test case sum the shipment sizes per name in a std::map, copy to a vector of (-count, name) pairs and sort, which gives decreasing count with alphabetical tie-break (std::string comparison matches the footnote's definition, shorter prefix first). Print the number of distinct toys and then the list. O(N log N) per test.
